units.source_text: 友子站起身走了过来，在布景的一头屈膝蹲下来。

en.t: Tomoko stood up and came over, then bent her knees and crouched down at one end of the set.

units.source_text: 大伙的视线一齐集中过去，

en.t: Everyone's eyes turned toward her all at once,

units.source_text: 她那施了厚厚一层白粉的脸颊倏地飞起一片红潮。

en.t: and a sudden flush rose over her cheeks, which were covered in a thick layer of white powder.

units.source_text: 连记者都不好意思地沉默了。

en.t: Even the reporter fell silent in embarrassment.

units.source_text: 手足无措的友子，漫不经心地微微点了点头，

en.t: At a loss for what to do, Tomoko gave a faint, absent-minded nod,

units.source_text: 布景画家一边目送着她，一边说：

en.t: The set painter watched her go and said:
